for name in ("TRITON_CACHE_DIR","TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR","CUDA_CACHE_PATH"):
    assert not Path(os.environ[name]).exists(),name+" not initially empty"
p=Path("/work/research/irc-baseline-config-v3.json")
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="61529de3e7cf2e865d147ca11e54388590bb50e12d8702c388adb2ed7702f7be"
c=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256((Path("/work")/c["preregistration"]["protocol"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c["preregistration"]["sha256"]
sys.path.insert(0,"/work/scripts")
from collections import Counter
import pytest,torch
from irc_baseline_support import prepare_inputs,payload_sha256
from projection_transport_steering.reft_training import epoch_batches
assert not torch.cuda.is_available()
tokenizer,examples,rows=prepare_inputs(c,Path("/work"),Path(c["model_path"]))
hist=Counter()
for epoch in range(c["recipe"]["epochs"]):
    groups=epoch_batches(examples,c["recipe"]["seed"],epoch,c["recipe"]["batch_size"])
    assert payload_sha256(groups)==c["recipe"]["epoch_order_sha256"][epoch]
    for group in groups:
        for start in range(0,len(group),2):
            width=max(len(examples[i]["input_ids"]) for i in group[start:start+2])
            hist[next(b for b in c["recipe"]["padding_buckets"] if b>=width)]+=1
assert dict(hist)=={384:6432,896:2154,2816:414}
print(json.dumps({"event":"baseline_v3_exact_inputs","status":"pass","fit":len(examples),"selection":len(rows),"source_files":len(c["source_sha256"]),"targets_sha256":payload_sha256(examples),"epoch_hashes":12,"bucket_histogram":dict(hist),"zero_shares":[len(x) for x in c["zero_shares"]],"GPU":False}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["-q","tests/test_irc_baseline_failures.py","tests/test_irc_baseline.py","--tb=short","-o","cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache","--junitxml=/out/native-tests.xml"]))
